data.name: Anwarun
data.gender_notes: Anwarun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name of Allah meaning light, radiance, and illumination. The name Anwarun carries the meaning “Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Anwarun usually hope their child will grow to embody light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the inner light that guides us through life
data.etymology: Anwarun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anwarun total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: أَنوَرون
in_arabic.long_meaning: أَنوَرونُ مَعنًى بِالنُورِ مُتَوَفِّقٌ بِالجودِ وَالرِضا وَالسَعادة، وَهُوَ مِنْ أَعزَمِ الأَسْماءِ الَّتي يُصافِها رَسولُ اللَهِ صلّى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَيُعتَبَرُ أَنوَرونَ الَّذي يَومِضُ النورُ عَلى دِهانهُ وَيُعطيهِ مِنَ اللَهِ مَعَ الشُكرِ وَالتَقَدُّمِ، وَهَذِهِ الْمَعنًى مُعَرَّفَةٌ فِي اللُغَةِ الْعَرَبِ وَهِيَ عَنِ قَولِ اللَهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فِي الْقُرْآنِ الْكَرِيمِ مَضِيَةً

in_urdu.name: انورون
in_urdu.meaning: انورون نور کی پوری طرح عطا کرتے ہیں اور جود و رضا کے ساتھ خوشی کے ساتھ بھی
in_urdu.long_meaning: انورون کی معنیں نور کی پوری طرح عطا کرتے ہیں اور جود و رضا کے ساتھ خوشی کے ساتھ ہیں۔ یہ ایک اچھی اور اہم اصطلاح ہے جس کا حوالہ پیغمبر اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ و سلم کی طرف کیے گئے خطبات میں ملتا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے کہ وہ شخص جس کی زندگی میں روشنی ہو اور جسے اللہ تعالیٰ نے جود و رضا کے ساتھ خوشی دی ہو۔ اللہ تعالیٰ نے اس کا ذکر قرآن کریم میں بھی کیا ہے

in_hindi.name: अनवरुन
in_hindi.meaning: अनवरुन में नूर की पूर्णता होती है और जो लोग जीते हैं उन्हें भी नूर की पूर्णता होती है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अनवरुन में नूर की पूर्णता होती है और जो लोग जीते हैं उन्हें भी नूर की पूर्णता होती है और जो लोग उनको मिलते हैं उन्हें भी नूर की पूर्णता होती है। यह एक अच्छा नाम है जिसका उल्लेख कुरान में भी है। यह लोगों के जीवन में नूर को बढ़ावा देने का काम करते हैं और जो लोग उन्हें प्यार करते हैं वो भी नूर की पूर्णता को प्राप्त करते हैं

in_english.name: Anwarun
in_english.meaning: Anwarun, the one who illuminates with the light of Allah, and is endowed with wisdom and piety
in_english.long_meaning: Anwarun, the one who illuminates with the light of Allah, and is endowed with wisdom and piety. The name Anwarun is derived from the Arabic root 'anw', which means 'light', and is often associated with the Arabic word 'anwar', which means 'lights' or 'beams'. In Islamic tradition, Anwarun is considered a blessed name, as it is believed to bring the blessings of Allah's light and wisdom to those who bear it. The name Anwarun is often associated with the attributes of Allah, such as wisdom, knowledge, and guidance.

data.cultural_impact: Anwarun is an Arabic name for both males and females in the Islamic tradition. It holds a significant cultural impact as it is derived from the name of Allah, the supreme deity in Islam, and represents the belief in the power and light of the divine. The name Anwarun is associated with knowledge, guidance, and illumination, which are essential virtues for every Muslim.
data.spiritual_significance: Anwarun signifies the spiritual journey towards enlightenment and the inner light that guides believers in their faith. The name underscores the belief in God as the ultimate source of light and guidance that illuminates the hearts and minds of His followers, leading them on the progressive path towards salvation. Anwarun also suggests the importance of knowledge and wisdom in the pursuit of a closer relationship with Allah and a more fulfilling life in both the physical and spiritual realms.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Light" symbolizes A name of Allah meaning light, radiance, and illumination. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Anwarun serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of light.
